'''Decimillipede''' is an {{2|Elites|Elite Enemy}} found in the {{2|Hive}}. It appears as three identical segments that fight together.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Decimillipede}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Bulk
|Intent = Attack2, Buff
|Effect = Deals (6;{{Asc2|9|7}}) damage. Gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Writhe
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (5x2;{{Asc2|9|6x2}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Outgas
|Intent = Attack2, Debuff
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage. Applies 1 {{BD2|Weak}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Weak
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Reattach
|Intent = Heal
|Effect = Revives with 25 HP (if other segments are alive).
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Each segment cycles through the following pattern:
# {{Int2|Decimillipede|Bulk}}
# {{Int2|Decimillipede|Writhe}}
# {{Int2|Decimillipede|Outgas}}
Each segment starts on a different move, which will remain the case until one or more of them is killed.
* When a segment is killed, it uses {{Int2|Decimillipede|Reattach}} to revive with 25 HP provided at least one other segment is still alive. After reviving, it resumes with a random move. which may disrupt their prior synchrony.

== Interactions ==
=== Anti-Synergies ===
* Because {{BD2|Doom}} triggers ''after'' '''Decimillipede''' segments will have regenerated via {{Int2|Decimillipede|Reattach}}, it can sometimes lead to scenarios wherein one or more segments are actively dying via Doom, but not until after the other(s) have respawned. Which can reoccur the following turn, depending on the player's Doom sources.
** {{BD2|Poison}} triggers ''before'' enemy moves, and does not suffer from this same issue.

== Trivia ==
* This fight is functionally similar to the {{M|Darkling|Darklings}} from Slay the Spire 1, with the same dynamic of 3 enemies that will revive if any of the others are alive.
* Using a {{P2|Beetle Juice}} potion on a segment doesn't shrink it visually, however the potion effect remains unchanged.
* Reducing the HP of one of them to 0 does not count as a '''{{2|Fatal}}''' kill unless it was the final enemy.
